title: Architecture review journey
instructions:
## Purpose
Review the user journey from receiving an architecture review URL to inspecting evidence, leaving comments, and requesting follow-up work from the coding agent.

## Regeneration
Inspect specs/user-review-architecture.spec.tsx, specs/user-comment-architecture.spec.tsx, specs/agent-follow-up-review.spec.ts, src/client/pages/workspace-page.tsx, src/client/parts/annotation-layer.tsx, and skills/architecture-companion/review-follow-up.md. Reconstruct the actor-observed review steps, including dependency focus interactions and comment targets, without expanding the internal server or rendering implementation.

nodes.title: Hand off review URL
nodes.description: The coding agent hands the local review URL it prepared to the reviewer.

nodes.title: Review diagrams and sources
nodes.description: The reviewer inspects the process and design diagrams and opens source evidence. In a dependency graph, hovering a route highlights it; selecting a group, node, or aggregate label focuses related edges, and clicking the blank canvas clears focus.

nodes.title: Comment on a diagram
nodes.description: When Comment mode is on, the reviewer leaves a comment at the relevant spot. A comment on an aggregated dependency relation records its endpoints and the IDs of all underlying edges.

nodes.title: Send a follow-up request to the coding agent
nodes.description: The reviewer sends the coding agent a follow-up request based on the review results.
